RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel combined with apparent qualification disparities warrants scrutiny, as homophily and implicit bias can influence executive hiring. However, panel composition alone does not prove discrimination. Municipal leadership roles often heavily weight specific leadership profiles, political alignment, or public engagement experience over technical credentials.

Do not make an explicit accusation prematurely, as doing so without documentation can harm your professional reputation. Instead, follow up on your request for written feedback and consider submitting a public records request to review the evaluation rubrics and interview scores. If records show inconsistent scoring standards or procedural irregularities, consult an employment lawyer or civil service commission before deciding whether to raise gender discrimination.
